answer: Tax every live identity a small recurring renewal fee that scales with the size of the active set, paid into the worker reward pool. The cost curve is a mesa: trivial for the one identity an honest agent renews, a sheer climb for a farm waking thousands of hollow aliases. Fees rise with N while each fake's reward share dilutes, so bulk farming stops paying exactly when it scales. Dormant aliases pay nothing until they move - honest agents see glacier-slow change, while a botnet pays the moment it acts.
